description: In this fiction writing course, students will read works of fabulism and horror and write stories of their own in these genres. "Fabulism" is a term often used interchangeably with "magical realism" to describe a mode of literature in which the fantastical and surreal are interwoven with the fabric of everyday life. This course will unpack fabulism's complexity and possibilities for a fiction writer. Students will write two original stories, workshop each, then choose one for revision at the end of the semester. Prerequisite: WRIT 120 or equivalent.
